audit.minimalProbeMethod: Choose one failure per new family by missed attack > false block > wrong risk > wrong injection; report probabilities break attack/block ties. Replay exact original, then greedily delete one eligible benign input at a time and retain a deletion only while the selected exact symptom persists on the selected model. Repeat until no further eligible deletion preserves it. Keep complete mandate, action, labels and all family-specific command/quote/disguise signals. Score final state on both models. HTTP probabilities are retained exactly as returned by Laya (four decimals).
